blocks.text: 1. Top-k Sampling
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785446292950-75135841.png

Temperature's own closing recap, already covered in Temperature, pointed forward here. Top-k Sampling, a technique restricting choices to only the most likely tokens, takes a genuinely different approach to controlling randomness.
It genuinely cuts the vocabulary down before any random sampling actually happens, a mechanism explored in full throughout this topic.
2. Recapping The Preview

This connects back to Temperature's own closing recap, already covered in Temperature. Top-k sampling was genuinely previewed there as a technique restricting choices to top tokens, briefly described in that earlier topic.
This topic genuinely gives it the complete, dedicated treatment already promised, exploring every detail already hinted at generally in that earlier topic.
3. Recapping Truncation Strategies

This connects back to truncation strategies, already covered generally in Sampling. Temperature, already covered in Temperature, reshapes the distribution but genuinely still leaves every word possible.
Top-k sampling genuinely takes a different approach: removing options entirely before sampling, a genuinely distinct truncation strategy explored throughout the rest of this topic.
4. Keeping Only The Top K Words

blocks.alt: Keeping Only The Top K Words
blocks.text: https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785446292951-941507496.png
This connects back to recapping truncation strategies, already covered in this topic. Top-k sampling genuinely keeps only the k highest probability words and genuinely discards everything else.
Sampling then genuinely happens only among that genuinely small, restricted set of words, the exact core mechanism explored throughout the rest of this topic.

blocks.text: 5. Renormalizing After Restriction
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785446292951-667009030.png
This connects back to keeping only the top k words, already covered in this topic. After genuinely discarding the rest, the remaining k probabilities genuinely no longer sum to one.
They genuinely get renormalized so sampling still genuinely behaves like a proper probability distribution, a genuinely necessary technical detail explored throughout the rest of this topic.

blocks.title: info
blocks.content: This renormalization step, already covered in this topic, directly explains why top-k sampling still genuinely produces valid, well behaved probabilities even after genuinely discarding most of the original vocabulary.

blocks.text: 6. Choosing K Value
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785446292952-307696710.png
This connects back to renormalizing after restriction, already covered in this topic. A genuinely small k value genuinely produces safer, more predictable output.

A genuinely larger k value genuinely allows more variety, closer to unrestricted random sampling, already covered generally in Sampling, a genuinely real, tunable tradeoff explored throughout the rest of this topic.

blocks.text: 7. Fixed K Across Varying Distributions
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785446292952-885912064.png
This connects back to choosing a k value, already covered in this topic. A genuinely fixed k value genuinely behaves very differently across different prediction steps.
Sometimes genuinely keeping only truly strong candidates, sometimes genuinely including fairly weak ones too, a genuinely real limitation explored throughout the rest of this topic.

blocks.title: info
blocks.content: This inconsistency, already covered in this topic, directly motivates Top-p Sampling, covered as the next topic in this module, which genuinely adapts its own cutoff based on the actual shape of each distribution instead of a fixed count.

blocks.text: 11. Key Takeaways

items: Top-k sampling restricts choices to only the k most likely tokens before sampling.
Unlike temperature, which reshapes the distribution, top-k sampling removes options entirely.
Only the k highest probability words are kept; everything else is discarded.
The remaining k probabilities get renormalized so they still sum to one.
A smaller k value produces safer output; a larger k value allows more variety.
A fixed k value behaves inconsistently across different prediction steps and distributions.
Top-k sampling and temperature are commonly used together, layered one after the other.
It prevents truly unlikely, nonsensical words from ever being sampled at all.
Next up: Top-p Sampling, which adapts its cutoff to the shape of each distribution instead.
